note: Every vendored file, its upstream path, the commit it came from and its digest. A file whose digest differs from sourceDigest must carry a patches[] entry.

.github/TEAM_MEMBERS.note: required by the CLI build; declared by upstream nix/node_modules.nix as part of the pruned checkout

bun.lock.note: Regenerated after removing @opencode/pty from three manifests: 18 packages removed (the package and its seven platform variants, plus one more). Verified no @opencode/* registry artifact remains.

packages/cli/package.json.note: Removed the @opencode/pty dependency. The helper is now built from vendor/engine/packages/process-daemon and resolved through BASHWINK_PTY_DIR or OPENCODE_PTY_BIN.

packages/cli/script/opencode-pty.ts.note: Refuses a cross-target build. A local artifact directory holds one platform's helper, and returning it for a different target labelled an arm64 Mach-O binary as linux-x64 — a build that looks successful and ships an unrunnable executable. Found by probing resolveOpencodePty for linux-x64 while BASHWINK_PTY_DIR held the darwin-arm64 helper.

packages/core/package.json.note: Removed the @opencode/pty dependency. The core PTY binding imports ./local-pty.js instead.

packages/core/src/persistent-pty/local-p.note: Replaces the @opencode/pty registry package. Supplied a local artifact path, version and SHA-256, and a binaryPath export, so the core PTY binding no longer requires a registry package. Fails loudly when no local helper exists rather than falling back to PATH or the registry.

packages/core/src/persistent-pty/pty-bin.note: Imports the local module instead of '@opencode/pty'. Not a re-export shim: a shim would reintroduce the dependency. The exported 'binding' shape is unchanged, so binary.bun.ts and its digest-validating install() are untouched.

packages/server/package.json.note: Removed the @opencode/pty devDependency: no test may resolve the registry PTY package, or a green suite would hide the dependency the migration removes.
